tips.text: Join a clan that already finished the Ghoulsaw research instead of building a Dojo yourself.
Expect to fund all five research projects yourself in a clan that has not done them; each waits on vault resources.
Plan a Plains fishing trip for the 15 Sharrac Teeth early; players forget the Blade needs fishing.
Look for the parts under the Miscellaneous tab, not Melee.
Expect the long common-resource list, mostly Plastids and Oxium, to be the whole pain; nobody calls it hard.
